policy.weight_provenance: Explicit engineering defaults based on research relevance and evidence assessment; not validated as optimal. Change before a new run and retain the previous configuration.
policy.selection_policy: Preserve one eligible snippet per query where possible, then fill by weighted API assessment. Positive, negative and null evidence use identical criteria. No named-paper, folder, ligand or comparator bonuses.
